text: Jantee -Onon ɓee gomɗimɓe wennjooɓe- tuma nde Alla fodunoo on wonnde poolgal ngal wonanay on e gootel e feddeeji sirkooɓe ɓen, hakkunde "iiru" e jawle maɓɓe jaɓiton fow, maa "nafiiru" foolon ɓe e hare, tawi non ko yiɗuɗon onon ko foolugol "iiru'en" fii hiɓe welani on fii, Alla non hino yiɗi goonginirgol goonga kan yamirgol on hare nden ; haɓon sirkooɓe ɓen, dahon ko ɗuuɗi e maɓɓe haa doole lislaamu ɗen ɓannga.
